speaker: CALLER
text: Hello sir, main Delhivery se bol raha hoon. Aapka parcel delivery ke liye aaya hai, main aapke building ke neeche hoon.

speaker: VICTIM
text: Haan, third floor pe aa jaiye.

speaker: CALLER
text: Sir lift kaam kar rahi hai?

speaker: CALLER
text: Theek hai. Delivery ke time ek OTP aayega aapke phone par, wo mujhe dikha dijiyega ya bata dijiyega, tabhi delivery complete hogi.

speaker: CALLER
text: Aur sir agar aap ghar par nahi hote to security ke paas chhod doon?

speaker: VICTIM
text: Nahi main ghar par hi hoon.
